title: AIRPLANE STATIONS - DESCRIPTION AND OPERATION
question: How do fuselage and wing stations help in determining the exact location of components relative to the firewall and wing tips on an aircraft?
answer: The airplane is laid out according to fuselage stations  and wing stations . These stations provide fixed reference points for all components located on or within the airplane. Fuselage Stations begin at the firewall  and extend to the tailcone area . Wing Stations begin at the root  and extend to the tip . Both Fuselage Stations and Wing Stations are measured in inches.
